name: Ravian Merii
source:
1st year student at Cherry Tree High. Vivian is an exchange student from Sweden and the daughter of the museum director at newly-built cultural center. Her father is a America-phile and Vivian speaks English well, but does have some misguided impressions about American culture.
She is a young girl with a straightforward and positive personality.
